name: web-scraper
description: A stealth web scraper that fetches the readable text content of any website by bypassing anti-bot measures.

read_webpage.description: Navigate to a URL using a stealth headless browser, wait for the page to load, and return the visible text content. Useful for reading articles, bypassing Cloudflare, or getting raw data from dynamic sites.

url.description: The exact URL of the website to scrape.
